message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/file && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/funcs.c","function":"file_buffer","line":254,"var":"m","code":"m = file_softmagic(ms, ubuf, nb, NULL, NULL, BINTEST, looks_text);","note":"The attacker-controlled input buffer is handed to the soft-magic matcher for interpretation."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/softmagic.c","function":"file_softmagic","line":91,"var":"buf/nbytes","code":"file_softmagic(ms, buf, nbytes, ...) iterates over the loaded magic rules and calls match()","note":"The raw bytes are propagated into the rule engine without copying or sanitizing the content."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/softmagic.c","function":"match","line":254,"var":"m","code":"if (print && mprint(ms, m) == -1) return -1;","note":"When a rule matches, match() prints the rule description by calling mprint(), which consumes fields populated by the rule evaluation."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/softmagic.c","function":"mprint","line":446,"var":"p->s","code":"case FILE_STRING: ... char *str = p->s;","note":"For string-like magic entries, mprint() reads the union VALUETYPE string field that was filled during matching."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/der.c","function":"der_cmp","line":328,"var":"ms->ms_value.s","code":"strlcpy(ms->ms_value.s, buf, sizeof(ms->ms_value.s));","note":"DER parsing copies a derived string into ms->ms_value.s; if the derived data is not properly initialized or terminated, later printing can read past the intended bytes."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/softmagic.c","function":"mprint","line":708,"var":"file_printable(sbuf, sizeof(sbuf), ms->ms_value.s)","code":"if (file_printf(ms, F(ms, m, \"%s\"), file_printable(sbuf, sizeof(sbuf), ms->ms_value.s)) == -1) return -1;","note":"The sink converts the string field to printable form and formats it, which is where the uninitialized-value read is observed by MSan."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
